note: The free table's practice shots, in menu order. Each names a position in core/tests/fixtures/positions that carries a strike (the shots measured from broadcasts: docs/calibration/targets.md, the filmed shots); title and hint are the words the player sees.

shots.title: Selby: blue, three cushions
shots.hint: Top and right side, very hard. Three cushions round to the reds on the pink.

shots.title: Trump: black, screw and left side
shots.hint: Deep screw. Baulk and side cushions, then back to the reds.

shots.title: Trump: black, screw and check side
shots.hint: Screw and right side. Two cushions, back up to the red on the cushion.

shots.title: Allen: thin blue, two cushions
shots.hint: Top and left side. Baulk and side cushions, back up the table to the pink.

shots.title: O'Sullivan: brown, baulk cushion
shots.hint: Follow. Off the baulk cushion and the length of the table to the pink.

shots.title: O'Sullivan: black, straight back
shots.hint: A little follow. Off the top cushion, back to clip the red on the pink spot.

shots.title: Lee: black, hugging the cushion
shots.hint: Top, nearly full. Off the top cushion, then pulled back along it into the red.

shots.title: Selby: blue, one cushion
shots.hint: Follow, very hard. Off the side cushion to the reds by the top cushion.

shots.title: Higgins: follow and left side
shots.hint: Off the baulk cushion, wide of the natural line, into the ball by the cushion.
